item.title: A quick reply to Murph's check-in picks up where it left off
item.summary: When Murph messages you first, like when a game starts, a short reply such as "Sure" now continues that conversation.
item.details: Before, Murph could lose track of a message it sent on its own and answer something older instead. Now every message Murph sends in your chat is part of the conversation it replies to.
